verdict.rationale: Together's serverless docs describe automatic prompt-prefix caching. It needs no header, parameter, or toggle, and repeated prefixes still warm in the shared cache are billed at a steeply discounted cached rate on select serverless chat models. That directly delivers cost reduction on repeated context. Missing for 10: any documented latency benefit, the list of supported models, details on cache TTL or hit reporting, caching on dedicated endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
